# H&S Labour Brokers

> H&S Labour Brokers is a South African recruitment and labour broking firm operating since 1998 (25+ years). It provides permanent and contract recruitment, Temporary Employment Services (TES / labour broking), payroll, vetting and background screening, HR & IR management, and CV response handling to employers across South Africa. Registered with the Department of Employment and Labour.

## Services
- [Permanent & Contract Recruitment](https://hslabour.co.za/services/recruitment): Sourcing, screening and placing skilled candidates, with a guaranteed replacement period.
- [Temporary Employment Services (TES)](https://hslabour.co.za/services/tes): Supply of temporary/contract workforce; H&S handles payroll, statutory compliance (incl. LRA s198A deeming and joint-and-several liability) and IR.
- [Payroll & Timesheets](https://hslabour.co.za/services/payroll): Payroll administration, timesheet capture, PAYE/UIF/SDL deductions and payslips.
- [Vetting & Risk Screening](https://hslabour.co.za/services/vetting): Criminal and credit checks, qualification verification, psychometric and skills assessments, fraud detection.
- [HR & IR Management](https://hslabour.co.za/services/hr-ir): Employment contracts, policies, disciplinary processes, CCMA representation and labour-law compliance.
- [CV Response Handling](https://hslabour.co.za/services/cv-response): Advertising, receiving, screening and shortlisting applications so employers review only pre-qualified candidates.

## Locations served
Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban, Gqeberha and Bloemfontein — and employers across South Africa.
